comment: Curated compatibility knowledge. level: measured = observed in-client by a named source; reported = claimed by a named source, not re-verified here; inferred = our reasoning. Never used to hide an API; only to annotate it.

target.note: Forever runs the Retail client (WOW_PROJECT_MAINLINE). Interface 16001 per forever-addon-kit measurements.

removedGlobals.comment: Globals that the kit reports are ABSENT on Forever (Classic-era names). Absence in our snapshot is checked too: only names also missing from the bundled index are flagged as confirmed-absent.
removedGlobals.source: forever-addon-kit README, 'It is the Retail client' (build 1.60.1.69893)

notes.text: ReloadUI() is protected: addon 'Reload UI' buttons are blocked. Instruct the user to type /reload.
RegisterEvent with an event name that does not exist throws and aborts the file. Wrap registrations of uncertain events in pcall.
GetBuildInfo() reports 16001 on Forever. Code that tests select(4, GetBuildInfo()) >= 100000 to detect a modern client takes the Classic path or refuses to load.

Midnight-style secret values: in combat, unit health, aura data and many numbers are secret. Never compare, branch on, do arithmetic on, or concatenate a possibly-secret value. Test with issecretvalue / canaccessvalue first.

In combat UnitHealth/UnitHealthPercent/UnitHealthMissing were secret for player and target in the kit's solo sample; target UnitHealthMax too. Drive health bars with StatusBar widgets rather than Lua maths on the value.
notes.source: forever-addon-kit README (health is secret in combat)

notes.text: Tainted code may not pass secret numbers to Cooldown:SetCooldown. Use C_Spell.GetSpellCooldownDuration / C_UnitAuras.GetAuraDuration -> Cooldown:SetCooldownFromDurationObject.
While C_Secrets.ShouldAurasBeSecret() is true, reading a secret aura throws. Secrecy is per spell: ask C_Secrets.GetSpellAuraSecrecy / ShouldSpellAuraBeSecret.
The combat log is restricted and CombatLogGetCurrentEventInfo is absent. Use UNIT_COMBAT and the built-in C_DamageMeter / PLAYER_SWING events.
Built-in swing timer events exist. C_SwingTimer range check is closed to addons (returns nil / checksRange=false); infer melee from recent PLAYER_SWING.

Early beta builds wrote SavedVariables on exit but never loaded them back (Blizzard bug, confirmed by several authors). Status on the current build is unverified here; test in game before relying on persistence.
notes.source: forever-addon-kit README; Blizzard forum thread cited there

notes.text: Secure snippets (WrapScript, _onstate-*, RunAttribute) threw 'attempt to call a nil value' before build 1.60.1.70009; reported fixed on 70009. Do not probe loadstring_untainted: it is nil by design. Test by running a snippet.
After 100 Lua errors in a session the client stops delivering them to handlers. Fix error floods first.

Protected functions (spell casting, target changes, frame show/hide on secure frames, etc.) cannot be called from insecure addon code in combat (InCombatLockdown). The IDE never attempts to bypass this; use SecureActionButtonTemplate / SecureHandlers. Query C_RestrictedActions for the live state.
notes.source: general WoW addon security model; C_RestrictedActions is present in the bundled index
